title: Esben
subtitle: Instead of using Linkedin or Substack, I'll keep this blog to reach you. I'm still right here. Too much fussing about the platform took my mind off writing. And it is writing I want to do practice in order to get better, and in order to share my life. I should have been doing this much sooner, much much sooner. Things would have been so different. But there's only left to look forward, so I'll try to make up for lost time.
